styles.name: Flat
styles.dark: Keep the semantic near-black page and opaque role-separated planes. No simulated top-light gradient: hierarchy comes from fill, ink and functional boundaries.
styles.shadow: None for strict flat. Selecting the taxonomy style does not silently override an independently configured floating Surface; strict-flat composition must select a compatible Surface.
styles.glow: None.
styles.highlight: None.
styles.stroke: W: semantic/required edges hold; ordinary decorative edges obey Surface.
styles.compact: No extra layer to shrink. Keep contrast and stroke widths; only Area geometry changes.

styles.name: Material / paper
styles.dark: Use a dark opaque sheet with a distinguishable foreground plane. A quiet top edge can suggest thickness; do not make the entire page grey to rescue an invisible shadow.
styles.shadow: S: keep permitted dark cast by role; omit Card halo. Local sheet contact modeling follows G only if calibrated.
styles.glow: None; reflected edge is not emission.
styles.highlight: H: restrained edge reflection, not a glossy band.
styles.stroke: W: a stable edge supplies separation where cast vanishes.
styles.compact: Drop secondary contact shading in repeated rows. A compact popover keeps floating depth; sm has less perimeter budget than lg.

styles.name: Transparency
styles.dark: Use dark semantic tint over the actual backdrop with a protected content plane. A flat black backdrop may reveal no transmission; accept that rather than inventing ambient light.
styles.shadow: S: only a separately elevated role casts; transparency alone gives no height.
styles.glow: None.
styles.highlight: None by default; adding reflection changes the layered composition.
styles.stroke: W: retain an independent readable boundary when identification requires it.
styles.compact: B holds backdrop treatment; compact does not lower opacity. Simplify to an opaque tonal plane where dense contents cannot tolerate variation.

styles.name: Glassmorphism
styles.dark: Use dark tint plus backdrop scattering, a restrained lit rim and an opaque or protected content region. A pale rim separates glass from near-black without a white body wash.
styles.shadow: S: one shell cast; G for a small optional inset edge shadow.
styles.glow: None unless emission is explicitly composed; a rim stays sharp.
styles.highlight: H: shorten or reduce reflection coverage near labels; soft band dimensions follow painted height.
styles.stroke: W: rim clipped to actual glass contour; required edge survives transparency.
styles.compact: B holds backdrop blur. Compact removes secondary reflections before changing body opacity; sm uses a single rim when double geometry cannot fit.

styles.name: Acrylic (Fluent)
styles.dark: Adapt the task-01 acrylic layer stack to a darker tint/luminosity treatment with fine texture and readable tonal plane. Keep light confined to an edge, not a luminous haze across all contents. This is an Area translation, not native Fluent parity.
styles.shadow: S: shell cast belongs to floating role, not each nested acrylic child.
styles.glow: None.
styles.highlight: H: matte/frosted response; no compulsory glossy reflection.
styles.stroke: W: modest contour contrast and separate functional boundary.
styles.compact: B holds blur/texture frequency; compact lowers texture prominence around text. G only scales local edge modeling, not scene blur.

styles.name: Mica
styles.dark: Use a stable dark, substantially opaque base with a restrained environmental tint and differentiated foreground planes. Do not turn a background material into clear glass to show an empty black backdrop.
styles.shadow: S: only a role requiring lift casts; no per-row elevation.
styles.glow: None.
styles.highlight: No mandatory specular band; any added reflection is a separate finish.
styles.stroke: W: local pane edge may carry hierarchy without a broad halo.
styles.compact: Hold environmental treatment as density changes. Dense content remains calm and opaque; material scale follows its containing plane, not every child size.

styles.name: Liquid Glass (Apple, 2025)
styles.dark: Keep a controlled dark body/readable core while rim reflections and any backdrop displacement describe the boundary. On flat near-black, refraction can be visually absent; do not compensate with a universal neon halo. A CSS experiment is not Apple renderer equivalence.
styles.shadow: S for permitted cast; avoid dark-smear stacking around nested glass.
styles.glow: No default emission; reflected spectral color is not a glow source.
styles.highlight: H: shape-following specular reflection; displacement amplitude, if used, needs its own G-calibrated painted body and content exclusion.
styles.stroke: W: shared contour for reflection/refraction mask and fallback edge.
styles.compact: Remove displacement and extra reflection lobes first for small/dense bodies; retain opaque semantic core. B does not scale backdrop blur from hit-target height.

styles.name: Neumorphism
styles.dark: Near-black removes room for the dark relief lobe. Model a local lighter top/rim against a distinct body, retain a dark contact side if useful, and add the required boundary. Equal light/dark external lobes are not a contrast solution.
styles.shadow: S disallows external lobes under Flat; G scales permitted local relief. Do not brighten the page just to display a shadow.
styles.glow: None; the light lobe is modeled reflection, not emission.
styles.highlight: H: one directional lit bevel or top plane, restrained around text.
styles.stroke: W: explicit identification edge where needed, independent of soft relief.
styles.compact: Sm and compact simplify to inset/edge modeling when paired lobes invade neighbors; lg can retain more relief only within absorption caps.

styles.name: Claymorphism
styles.dark: Use an opaque dark body with a soft lighter crown and a readable perimeter. Preserve local volume without converting the whole object to pale plastic.
styles.shadow: S for cast, G for rounded inset shading; no extra external lobe under Flat.
styles.glow: None by default.
styles.highlight: H: soft crown scales to painted body; keep its bright area off small text.
styles.stroke: W: readable core contour plus optional soft edge modeling.
styles.compact: Compact reduces crown coverage and drops secondary inset layers. Sm may lose the plush effect; do not secretly increase its radius to keep it.

styles.name: Skeuomorphism
styles.dark: Translate the chosen substance, not just the light screenshot: dark metal/rubber/wood need different body paints but share legible ink, local light direction and a near-black surrounding page.
styles.shadow: S for cast; G for explicit local relief only. Texture is not elevation.
styles.glow: E only for genuinely luminous indicators in the composition.
styles.highlight: H follows the chosen finish; matte controls do not inherit chrome gloss.
styles.stroke: W: physical-looking perimeter cannot replace required semantic boundary.
styles.compact: Remove tiny seams, deep grooves and texture contrast before shrinking functional strokes. This umbrella style needs a specific substance preset to calibrate any numbers.

styles.name: Aqua
styles.dark: Use a dark colored gel/plastic body, subdued glossy upper reflection and a coherent rim. A light-theme white gloss band cannot simply be pasted above pale dark-mode text.
styles.shadow: S for allowed cast; G for body concavity/contact modeling.
styles.glow: No automatic bloom; compose E only for a deliberate luminous accent.
styles.highlight: H: band depth follows painted height, with label exclusion and wrap at the ends.
styles.stroke: W: simplify double rims to one when clearance is insufficient.
styles.compact: Compact/sm use one gloss cue; lg may support a separated lower rim subject to the same caps, never automatic added brightness.

styles.name: Frutiger Aero
styles.dark: Darken the environmental/body palette while retaining a selective glass/gloss accent. Keep imagery and sky-like brightness outside dense functional content; preserve the near-black page.
styles.shadow: S only at allowed surface relationships.
styles.glow: E only for intentional luminous accents; not a general colored haze.
styles.highlight: H: isolated specular band or disc reflection, not repeated on every Table cell.
styles.stroke: W: one coherent outer silhouette for each semantic body.
styles.compact: Compact collapses imagery, gloss and texture to a tonal body plus one cue. This is an aesthetic family, so a specific composition remains necessary for calibration.

styles.name: Glow / neon
styles.dark: Retain a crisp semantic emitter over the dark page and place a restrained colored halo outside or inside it. Brightness belongs to the emitter, not every container. Keep text labels unglowed unless separately approved display lettering.
styles.shadow: S only if a separate raised body exists; glow does not imply elevation.
styles.glow: E: G scales local halo reach, not core opacity; cap to adjacent content clearance.
styles.highlight: No obligatory key-light highlight; emission is independent of light angle.
styles.stroke: W: sharp core/boundary remains independent of blurred halo and focus.
styles.compact: Sm/compact shorten or remove outward halo first. Lg does not get a stronger core merely because its box is taller.

styles.name: Gradient fill — linear
styles.dark: Derive a dark semantic stop set. Use a lighter top only if the gradient models lighting; decorative color ramps need not follow the key light. Evaluate the full field beneath ink.
styles.shadow: None inherent; S governs any composed cast.
styles.glow: None inherent.
styles.highlight: B keeps normalized stops; H applies only when the fill intentionally acts as a reflection or modeled top.
styles.stroke: W independent of fill gradient; do not use its bright endpoint as the sole boundary.
styles.compact: B lets stop positions scale with the body; narrow contrast excursion or remove the ramp in dense text. No extra layer just because size becomes lg.

styles.name: Gradient fill — radial
styles.dark: Use a dark field with a controlled local brighter region. A radial fill is not an external glow; keep its bright center away from vulnerable text or change the paired ink plan.
styles.shadow: None inherent; S when composed.
styles.glow: Only E if separately painted outside the body.
styles.highlight: B scales a body-relative field; H if it models a crown. A scene-relative light spot can instead keep its own reference.
styles.stroke: W independent perimeter; the radial field must not erase one side of it.
styles.compact: Sm/compact keep one restrained spot or a flat plane; hold contrast across the entire radial transition, not endpoints alone.

styles.name: Gradient fill — conic
styles.dark: Use dark-compatible color stops with a controlled seam. Do not pass a decorative conic rotation off as a physical light source or repaint semantic progress data.
styles.shadow: None inherent; S when composed.
styles.glow: None inherent; E only for explicit emission.
styles.highlight: B holds angular stops; no compulsory top highlight.
styles.stroke: W independent contour; a gradient-stroke composition has its own row below.
styles.compact: Compact reduces contrast or removes the decorative conic field if the seam/center crowds text. G does not change angular stops with size.

styles.name: Gradient fill — mesh
styles.dark: Use a bounded dark multicolor field with local bright regions kept behind non-text space. A near-black page stays a semantic page rather than a full-screen luminous mesh.
styles.shadow: None inherent; S when composed.
styles.glow: None inherent; luminous-looking fill is still body paint.
styles.highlight: B scales normalized control points; any reflection is a separate H layer.
styles.stroke: W independent contour, evaluated against varying perimeter colors.
styles.compact: Sm/compact remove secondary color islands or reduce to an opaque tonal fill; larger surfaces may keep the mesh away from dense content, not increase all amplitudes.

styles.name: Gradient stroke
styles.dark: Keep a dark body and a directionally brighter rim, with a separate stable identification edge when the gradient fades. Distinguish decorative hue travel from lit-edge shading.
styles.shadow: S only for an independently elevated body.
styles.glow: None unless E is separately composed.
styles.highlight: H if the stroke models a lit edge; otherwise keep its authored angle.
styles.stroke: W: width holds; gradient runs inside the same offset contour. Do not multiply both width and alpha by q.
styles.compact: Compact/sm reduce stops or use one rim, retaining the functional edge. Lg gains no thicker functional boundary automatically.

styles.name: Inner shadow
styles.dark: Use a readable dark cavity and a subtle opposite lit lip; an all-black well on near-black cannot show the shadow. Preserve the field body rather than forcing a white halo.
styles.shadow: G scales inset offset, blur and spread, with sign preserved; S still governs any separate outer cast.
styles.glow: None.
styles.highlight: H: optional light lip opposite the shaded recess side.
styles.stroke: W: boundary stays explicit where needed; inset shade is not its substitute.
styles.compact: Compact/sm tighten the cavity band and remove it before it touches text. Tracks use their actual thin painted rail as reference, not the row height.

styles.name: Inner glow
styles.dark: Keep the glow inside a dark body and below crisp content. A brighter interior edge may describe emission or reflection; record which, rather than calling every light rim glow.
styles.shadow: None inherent; S when composed.
styles.glow: E for emission, G for inset glow reach; cap away from ink.
styles.highlight: H only if the effect is reclassified as reflection, not an additional automatic layer.
styles.stroke: W: maintain independent required edge and focus.
styles.compact: Sm/compact narrow or drop the luminous interior band; do not turn a recessed field into an evenly bright fill just to preserve glow strength.

styles.name: Outer glow
styles.dark: Keep a crisp source silhouette, a restrained halo and the dark page. Do not tint all surrounding text or let adjacent controls merge into one luminous cluster.
styles.shadow: None inherent; emission is not cast depth.
styles.glow: E: local halo extent follows G with clearance cap; opacity does not scale up.
styles.highlight: None inherent; emission does not require a directional top.
styles.stroke: W: semantic core and focus independent of halo.
styles.compact: Compact repeated controls remove external glow when clearance vanishes; lg may have more room but does not gain intensity automatically.

styles.name: Drop shadow
styles.dark: Retain dark cast where the receiving plane lets it read. Add a separate semantic edge or lighter body plane when it does not; do not invert the cast to white.
styles.shadow: S: current role casts hold across size/density; local sculpting is a different layer governed by G.
styles.glow: None.
styles.highlight: None inherent; any added rim/top is a separate reflection layer.
styles.stroke: W supplies necessary distinction where dark cast is ineffective.
styles.compact: A compact floating list keeps floating depth; dense rows do not each gain casts. Shadow choice follows role, not sm/md/lg names.

styles.name: Bevel / emboss
styles.dark: Use a light-facing rim/top and a restrained dark-facing edge around a dark body. Reverse relief polarity for a recess without reversing the semantic state or recoloring its ink.
styles.shadow: G for local shaded bevel; S for any external cast.
styles.glow: None.
styles.highlight: H: directional edge widths/depth follow the actual contour and local normal; avoid double-bright rounded corners.
styles.stroke: W: bevel depth may scale, required stroke does not. Shared rim path prevents nested corner drift.
styles.compact: Compact/sm collapse multi-step bevels to one light/dark edge pair or one semantic edge if they cannot fit.

styles.name: Letterpress
styles.dark: Keep readable light semantic ink on dark surfaces; any inscription effect uses a tiny offset rim/shade outside the ink, not dark low-contrast text chosen for realism.
styles.shadow: No body cast inherent; content decoration is not Surface elevation.
styles.glow: None.
styles.highlight: Content decoration follows glyph/letter scale, never the surrounding control q.
styles.stroke: Functional glyph strokes stay intact; no body rim implied.
styles.compact: Use none on normal dense labels/code. Optional display lettering scales from actual font geometry and drops the relief when small; larger control size alone never enables it.

styles.name: Grain
styles.dark: Use low-prominence texture on the dark body, preserving the near-black page and an untextured legible content plane. Grain changes texture, not geometric depth.
styles.shadow: None inherent; S when composed.
styles.glow: None.
styles.highlight: None inherent.
styles.stroke: W remains independent; texture does not establish a boundary.
styles.compact: B holds calibrated spatial frequency rather than stretching noise per component; compact/sm reduce coverage or remove grain around text. Lg does not automatically increase contrast.
